C-I-43 0 72 I 52 I 20 17-Ch e m -I( B) Government of India Ministry of Chemicals & Fertilizers Department of Chemicals & Petrochemicals *** Shastri Bhawan, New Delhi Dated : 26th November,2024 Subject: Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) Order 20L7 - Sulphuric Acid - regarding. Ref Depaftment for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) Order No.P.4502112120t7-PP (B.E.II) - Part (4) Vol.II dated L9.07.2024. The Government has issued Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) Order, 2017vide DPIITOTdeT No. P.4502U212017-PP (B.E.II) - Part (a) Vol.II dated 19.07.2024 to encourage "Make in India" and to promote manufacturing and production of goods, services and works in India with a view to enhance income and employment. 2. The para 2 of DPIIT Order No. P.4502U212017-PP (B.E.II) - Part (a) Vol.II dated 19.07.2024 defines the local content as follows :- 'Local Content' means the amount of value added in India which shall, unless othenrurise prescribed by the Nodal Ministry, be the total value of the item procured (excluding net domestic indirect taxes) minus the value of imported content in the item (including all custom duties) as a proportion of the total value, in percent. 3. In accordance with the para 2 of DPIIT's Order No. P-450211212077-8.E.-II dated 19.07.2024 mentioned at para 2 above, the calculation of local content with respect to Sulphuric Acid, only for Oil Manufacturing Units, which are producing sulphuric acid, is hereby prescribed as under: (Total value - Value of Imported Content #; x 100 / Total Value # Value of Imported content shall be Ocean Freight and Marine Insurance only for Imported Crude Oil. 4. Every procuring entity shall constitute a Committee with internal and external experts for independent verification of self-declaration and auditor's/accountant's ceftificates on random basis and for the complalnts that are received/referred. In case any clarification is needed by the Committee on any particular point, the matter may be referred to the following Committee in the Department of Chemicals & Petrochemicals:- (i) Joint Secretary (Chemicals) (ii) Representative of the PSU/Autonomous Body (iii) Director/Deputy Secretary (iv) Deputy Industrial Adviser, DCPC Chairman Member Member Member N o.
